headline: Brief Reports House Approval of Stronger Crop Insurance Measure
seoTitle: Brief: House Crop Insurance Reform Measure
seoDescription: An FMB News evening brief reports House approval of a measure strengthening PCIC coverage for farmers and fisherfolk.
deck: The newsroom package reports movement on legislation to strengthen agricultural insurance.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Official House records show multiple bills to strengthen or expand the Philippine Crop Insurance Corporation were consolidated or substituted by HB 10365, and Speaker Faustino Dy III has publicly pushed broader, faster and more digital crop insurance.

The August 16 newsroom brief reports that a stronger PCIC measure was approved on third reading with expanded coverage and a 30-day payout rule. FMB News could not independently retrieve the claimed same-day voting record, so the approval date and 30-day mandate remain source-attributed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Existing PCIC reform activity is independently documented; the exact August 16 third-reading result remains source-attributed.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Crop insurance is a key financial safety net for farmers and fisherfolk facing typhoons, floods, pests and other climate-related losses.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the House journal, HB 10365 text, Senate counterpart action and final PCIC claims-processing requirements.
